+use crate::api::JiraClient;
+use crate::cli::adf_text::render_adf_text;
+use crate::cli::format::{self, truncate};
+use crate::cli::style;
+use crate::cli::util::{self, parse_issue_key_arg, resolve_site};
+use crate::config::Config;
+use clap::{Args, Parser, Subcommand};
+
+#[derive(Parser, Debug)]
+pub struct CommentArgs {
+    #[command(subcommand)]
+    pub action: Option<CommentSubcommand>,
+    /// Issue key if adding a comment directly without subcommand
+    #[arg(required = false)]
+    pub key: Option<String>,
+    /// Comment body text (markdown)
+    #[arg(short = 'b', long)]
+    pub body: Option<String>,
+    /// Attach files (repeatable)
+    #[arg(long = "attach", value_name = "PATH")]
+    pub attach: Vec<std::path::PathBuf>,
+    /// Target site name
+    #[arg(long)]
+    pub site: Option<String>,
+}
+
+#[derive(Subcommand, Debug)]
+pub enum CommentSubcommand {
+    /// Add a comment to an issue
+    Add {
+        key: String,
+        #[arg(short = 'b', long)]
+        body: Option<String>,
+        #[arg(long = "attach", value_name = "PATH")]
+        attach: Vec<std::path::PathBuf>,
+        #[arg(long)]
+        site: Option<String>,
+    },
+    /// List comments on an issue
+    List {
+        key: String,
+        #[arg(long)]
+        site: Option<String>,
+    },
+    /// Delete a comment by ID
+    Delete {
+        key: String,
+        #[arg(long)]
+        id: String,
+        #[arg(long)]
+        site: Option<String>,
+    },
+}
+
+#[derive(Parser, Debug)]
+pub struct WorklogArgs {
+    #[command(subcommand)]
+    pub action: WorklogSubcommand,
+}
+
+#[derive(Subcommand, Debug)]
+pub enum WorklogSubcommand {
+    /// Log work spent on an issue (e.g. "2h 30m")
+    Add {
+        key: String,
+        #[arg(short = 't', long = "time")]
+        time_spent: String,
+        #[arg(long)]
+        site: Option<String>,
+    },
+    /// List worklogs on an issue
+    List {
+        key: String,
+        #[arg(long)]
+        site: Option<String>,
+    },
+    /// Delete a worklog entry by ID
+    Delete {
+        key: String,
+        #[arg(long)]
+        id: String,
+        #[arg(long)]
+        site: Option<String>,
+    },
+}
+
+#[derive(Parser, Debug)]
+pub struct LinkArgs {
+    #[command(subcommand)]
+    pub action: LinkSubcommand,
+}
+
+#[derive(Subcommand, Debug)]
+pub enum LinkSubcommand {
+    /// Link two issues together
+    Add {
+        inward_key: String,
+        outward_key: String,
+        /// Link type name (e.g. "Relates", "Blocks", "Clones", "Duplicate")
+        #[arg(short = 't', long, default_value = "Relates")]
+        link_type: String,
+        #[arg(long)]
+        site: Option<String>,
+    },
+    /// List links for an issue
+    List {
+        key: String,
+        #[arg(long)]
+        site: Option<String>,
+    },
+    /// Delete an issue link by link ID
+    Delete {
+        #[arg(long)]
+        id: String,
+        #[arg(long)]
+        site: Option<String>,
+    },
+}
+
+#[derive(Args, Debug)]
+pub struct WatchArgs {
+    pub key: String,
+    #[arg(long)]
+    pub site: Option<String>,
+}
+
+pub async fn run_comment(args: CommentArgs) -> Result<(), String> {
+    match args.action {
+        Some(CommentSubcommand::List { key, site }) => {
+            run_comment_list(&key, site.as_deref()).await
+        }
+        Some(CommentSubcommand::Delete { key, id, site }) => {
+            run_comment_delete(&key, &id, site.as_deref()).await
+        }
+        Some(CommentSubcommand::Add {
+            key,
+            body,
+            attach,
+            site,
+        }) => run_comment_add(&key, body, attach, site.as_deref()).await,
+        None => {
+            let key = args
+                .key
+                .ok_or_else(|| "Issue key required. See 'tick issue comment --help'".to_string())?;
+            run_comment_add(&key, args.body, args.attach, args.site.as_deref()).await
+        }
+    }
+}
+
+async fn run_comment_add(
+    key_raw: &str,
+    body_opt: Option<String>,
+    attach: Vec<std::path::PathBuf>,
+    site_opt: Option<&str>,
+) -> Result<(), String> {
+    let config = Config::load().map_err(|e| format!("Config error: {e}"))?;
+    let key = parse_issue_key_arg(key_raw)?;
+    let site = resolve_site(&config, &key, site_opt)?;
+    let base_url = site.base_url.trim_end_matches('/').to_string();
+    let body = util::read_body_arg(body_opt)?;
+    let client = JiraClient::from_config(&config, false)
+        .await
+        .map_err(|e| format!("Auth error: {e}"))?;
+
+    for p in &attach {
+        if !p.is_file() {
+            return Err(format!("File does not exist: {}", p.display()));
+        }
+    }
+
+    client
+        .add_comment_with_attachments(&base_url, &key, &body, &[], &attach)
+        .await?;
+    println!(
+        "{} Added comment to {}",
+        style::green("✓"),
+        style::bold(&key)
+    );
+    Ok(())
+}
+
+async fn run_comment_list(key_raw: &str, site_opt: Option<&str>) -> Result<(), String> {
+    let config = Config::load().map_err(|e| format!("Config error: {e}"))?;
+    let key = parse_issue_key_arg(key_raw)?;
+    let site = resolve_site(&config, &key, site_opt)?;
+    let base_url = site.base_url.trim_end_matches('/').to_string();
+    let client = JiraClient::from_config(&config, false)
+        .await
+        .map_err(|e| format!("Auth error: {e}"))?;
+
+    let comments = client.list_comments(&base_url, &key).await?;
+    if comments.is_empty() {
+        println!("{}", style::dim("No comments found."));
+        return Ok(());
+    }
+
+    for c in &comments {
+        let id = c.get("id").and_then(|v| v.as_str()).unwrap_or("?");
+        let author = c
+            .get("author")
+            .and_then(|a| a.get("displayName"))
+            .and_then(|d| d.as_str())
+            .unwrap_or("Unknown");
+        let created = c.get("created").and_then(|v| v.as_str()).unwrap_or("");
+        let body = c.get("body").map(render_adf_text).unwrap_or_default();
+
+        println!(
+            "{} {} ({})",
+            style::bold(author),
+            style::dim(&format!("[id: {id}]")),
+            style::dim(created)
+        );
+        for line in body.lines() {
+            println!("  {line}");
+        }
+        println!();
+    }
+    Ok(())
+}
+
+async fn run_comment_delete(
+    key_raw: &str,
+    comment_id: &str,
+    site_opt: Option<&str>,
+) -> Result<(), String> {
+    let config = Config::load().map_err(|e| format!("Config error: {e}"))?;
+    let key = parse_issue_key_arg(key_raw)?;
+    let site = resolve_site(&config, &key, site_opt)?;
+    let base_url = site.base_url.trim_end_matches('/').to_string();
+    let client = JiraClient::from_config(&config, false)
+        .await
+        .map_err(|e| format!("Auth error: {e}"))?;
+
+    client.delete_comment(&base_url, &key, comment_id).await?;
+    println!(
+        "{} Deleted comment {comment_id} from {}",
+        style::green("✓"),
+        style::bold(&key)
+    );
+    Ok(())
+}
+
+pub async fn run_worklog(args: WorklogArgs) -> Result<(), String> {
+    match args.action {
+        WorklogSubcommand::Add {
+            key,
+            time_spent,
+            site,
+        } => {
+            let config = Config::load().map_err(|e| format!("Config error: {e}"))?;
+            let key = parse_issue_key_arg(&key)?;
+            let site = resolve_site(&config, &key, site.as_deref())?;
+            let base_url = site.base_url.trim_end_matches('/').to_string();
+            let client = JiraClient::from_config(&config, false)
+                .await
+                .map_err(|e| format!("Auth error: {e}"))?;
+
+            client.add_worklog(&base_url, &key, &time_spent).await?;
+            println!(
+                "{} Logged {} on {}",
+                style::green("✓"),
+                style::cyan(&time_spent),
+                style::bold(&key)
+            );
+            Ok(())
+        }
+        WorklogSubcommand::List { key, site } => {
+            let config = Config::load().map_err(|e| format!("Config error: {e}"))?;
+            let key = parse_issue_key_arg(&key)?;
+            let site = resolve_site(&config, &key, site.as_deref())?;
+            let base_url = site.base_url.trim_end_matches('/').to_string();
+            let client = JiraClient::from_config(&config, false)
+                .await
+                .map_err(|e| format!("Auth error: {e}"))?;
+
+            let worklogs = client.list_worklogs(&base_url, &key).await?;
+            if worklogs.is_empty() {
+                println!("{}", style::dim("No worklogs found."));
+                return Ok(());
+            }
+
+            let headers = ["ID", "AUTHOR", "TIME SPENT", "STARTED"];
+            let rows: Vec<Vec<String>> = worklogs
+                .into_iter()
+                .map(|w| {
+                    let id = w
+                        .get("id")
+                        .and_then(|v| v.as_str())
+                        .unwrap_or("?")
+                        .to_string();
+                    let author = w
+                        .get("author")
+                        .and_then(|a| a.get("displayName"))
+                        .and_then(|d| d.as_str())
+                        .unwrap_or("Unknown")
+                        .to_string();
+                    let time = w
+                        .get("timeSpent")
+                        .and_then(|v| v.as_str())
+                        .unwrap_or("?")
+                        .to_string();
+                    let started = w
+                        .get("started")
+                        .and_then(|v| v.as_str())
+                        .unwrap_or("")
+                        .to_string();
+                    vec![id, author, time, started]
+                })
+                .collect();
+            format::print_table(&headers, &rows);
+            Ok(())
+        }
+        WorklogSubcommand::Delete { key, id, site } => {
+            let config = Config::load().map_err(|e| format!("Config error: {e}"))?;
+            let key = parse_issue_key_arg(&key)?;
+            let site = resolve_site(&config, &key, site.as_deref())?;
+            let base_url = site.base_url.trim_end_matches('/').to_string();
+            let client = JiraClient::from_config(&config, false)
+                .await
+                .map_err(|e| format!("Auth error: {e}"))?;
+
+            client.delete_worklog(&base_url, &key, &id).await?;
+            println!(
+                "{} Deleted worklog {id} from {}",
+                style::green("✓"),
+                style::bold(&key)
+            );
+            Ok(())
+        }
+    }
+}
+
+pub async fn run_link(args: LinkArgs) -> Result<(), String> {
+    match args.action {
+        LinkSubcommand::Add {
+            inward_key,
+            outward_key,
+            link_type,
+            site,
+        } => {
+            let config = Config::load().map_err(|e| format!("Config error: {e}"))?;
+            let key = parse_issue_key_arg(&inward_key)?;
+            let site = resolve_site(&config, &key, site.as_deref())?;
+            let base_url = site.base_url.trim_end_matches('/').to_string();
+            let client = JiraClient::from_config(&config, false)
+                .await
+                .map_err(|e| format!("Auth error: {e}"))?;
+
+            client
+                .link_issues(&base_url, &link_type, &inward_key, &outward_key)
+                .await?;
+            println!(
+                "{} Linked {} {} {}",
+                style::green("✓"),
+                style::bold(&inward_key),
+                style::cyan(&link_type),
+                style::bold(&outward_key)
+            );
+            Ok(())
+        }
+        LinkSubcommand::List { key, site } => {
+            let config = Config::load().map_err(|e| format!("Config error: {e}"))?;
+            let key = parse_issue_key_arg(&key)?;
+            let site = resolve_site(&config, &key, site.as_deref())?;
+            let base_url = site.base_url.trim_end_matches('/').to_string();
+            let client = JiraClient::from_config(&config, false)
+                .await
+                .map_err(|e| format!("Auth error: {e}"))?;
+
+            let relations = client.fetch_issue_relations(&base_url, &key).await?;
+            if relations.links.is_empty() {
+                println!("{}", style::dim("No linked issues found."));
+                return Ok(());
+            }
+
+            let headers = ["RELATION", "ISSUE", "SUMMARY", "STATUS"];
+            let rows: Vec<Vec<String>> = relations
+                .links
+                .into_iter()
+                .map(|l| {
+                    vec![
+                        format!("{} ({})", l.link_type, l.direction),
+                        l.other_key,
+                        truncate(&l.other_summary, 40),
+                        l.other_status,
+                    ]
+                })
+                .collect();
+            format::print_table(&headers, &rows);
+            Ok(())
+        }
+        LinkSubcommand::Delete { id, site: site_opt } => {
+            let config = Config::load().map_err(|e| format!("Config error: {e}"))?;
+            let site = if let Some(ref name) = site_opt {
+                config
+                    .sites
+                    .iter()
+                    .find(|s| s.name.eq_ignore_ascii_case(name))
+                    .ok_or_else(|| format!("Unknown site '{name}'"))?
+            } else {
+                config
+                    .sites
+                    .first()
+                    .ok_or_else(|| "No sites configured".to_string())?
+            };
+            let base_url = site.base_url.trim_end_matches('/').to_string();
+            let client = JiraClient::from_config(&config, false)
+                .await
+                .map_err(|e| format!("Auth error: {e}"))?;
+
+            client.delete_issue_link(&base_url, &id).await?;
+            println!("{} Deleted issue link {id}", style::green("✓"));
+            Ok(())
+        }
+    }
+}
+
+pub async fn run_watch(args: WatchArgs, unwatch: bool) -> Result<(), String> {
+    let config = Config::load().map_err(|e| format!("Config error: {e}"))?;
+    let key = parse_issue_key_arg(&args.key)?;
+    let site = resolve_site(&config, &key, args.site.as_deref())?;
+    let base_url = site.base_url.trim_end_matches('/').to_string();
+    let client = JiraClient::from_config(&config, false)
+        .await
+        .map_err(|e| format!("Auth error: {e}"))?;
+
+    if unwatch {
+        client.unwatch_issue(&base_url, &key).await?;
+        println!(
+            "{} Stopped watching {}",
+            style::green("✓"),
+            style::bold(&key)
+        );
+    } else {
+        client.watch_issue(&base_url, &key).await?;
+        println!("{} Now watching {}", style::green("✓"), style::bold(&key));
+    }
+    Ok(())
+}

+use crate::api::JiraClient;
+use crate::cli::format::{self, truncate};
+use crate::cli::style;
+use crate::cli::util::{self, IssueJson};
+use crate::config::{Config, Site};
+use crate::platform;
+use clap::Parser;
+
+#[derive(Parser, Debug)]
+pub struct IssueListArgs {
+    /// JQL query to filter issues
+    #[arg(short, long)]
+    pub jql: Option<String>,
+    /// Filter by assignee accountId or "me"
+    #[arg(short, long)]
+    pub assignee: Option<String>,
+    /// Filter by status name
+    #[arg(long)]
+    pub status: Option<String>,

+    #[arg(short, long)]
+    pub project: Option<String>,

+    #[arg(short = 'L', long, default_value = "30")]
+    pub limit: u32,

+    #[arg(short = 'w', long)]
+    pub web: bool,

+    #[arg(long)]
+    pub json: bool,

+    #[arg(short, long)]

+
+#[derive(Parser, Debug)]
+pub struct IssueViewArgs {
+    /// Issue key (e.g. PROJ-123)
+    pub key: String,
+    /// Include recent comments
+    #[arg(short, long)]
+    pub comments: bool,
+    /// Include linked issues
+    #[arg(short, long)]
+    pub links: bool,
+    /// Open issue in the web browser
+    #[arg(short = 'w', long)]
+    pub web: bool,
+    /// Output raw JSON
+    #[arg(long)]
+    pub json: bool,
+    /// Target site name from config
+    #[arg(short, long)]
+    pub site: Option<String>,

+
+pub async fn run_list(args: IssueListArgs) -> Result<(), String> {
+    let config = Config::load().map_err(|e| format!("Config error: {e}"))?;
+    let site = resolve_site(&config, args.site.as_deref())?;
+    let base_url = site.base_url.trim_end_matches('/').to_string();
+
+    let jql = build_jql(&args);
+
+    if args.web {
+        let web_url = format!("{base_url}/issues/?jql={}", urlencoding(&jql));
+        let _ = platform::open_url(&web_url);
+        println!("Opening {web_url} in browser");
+        return Ok(());
+    }
+
+    let client = JiraClient::from_config(&config, false)
+        .await
+        .map_err(|e| format!("Auth error: {e}"))?;
+
+    let mut progress = None;
+    let ids = client
+        .search_jql(&base_url, &jql, args.limit, &mut progress)
+        .await?;
+    let issues = client.bulk_fetch(&base_url, &ids, None, &[], false).await?;
+
+    if args.json {
+        let tickets: Vec<IssueJson> = issues
+            .into_iter()
+            .map(|i| {
+                let ticket = crate::api::types::Ticket::from_bulk_fetch(
+                    i,
+                    &site.name,
+                    &base_url,
+                    None,
+                    &[],
+                    false,
+                );
+                IssueJson::from_ticket(&ticket, &site.name)
+            })
+            .collect();
+        println!(
+            "{}",
+            serde_json::to_string_pretty(&tickets).unwrap_or_default()
+        );
+        return Ok(());
+    }
+
+    if issues.is_empty() {
+        println!("{}", style::dim("No issues found matching query."));
+        return Ok(());
+    }
+
+    let headers = ["KEY", "STATUS", "PRIORITY", "SUMMARY", "ASSIGNEE"];
+    let rows: Vec<Vec<String>> = issues
+        .into_iter()
+        .map(|i| {
+            let key = style::bold(&i.key);
+            let status = style::status_color(&i.fields.status.name);
+            let prio = style::priority_color(
+                i.fields
+                    .priority
+                    .as_ref()
+                    .map(|p| p.name.as_str())
+                    .unwrap_or("-"),
+            );
+            let summary = truncate(&i.fields.summary, 60);
+            let assignee = i
+                .fields
+                .assignee
+                .as_ref()
+                .map(|a| a.display_name.as_str())
+                .unwrap_or("-")
+                .to_string();
+            vec![key, status, prio, summary, assignee]
+        })
+        .collect();
+
+    format::print_table(&headers, &rows);
+    Ok(())
+}
+
+pub async fn run_view(args: IssueViewArgs) -> Result<(), String> {
+    let config = Config::load().map_err(|e| format!("Config error: {e}"))?;
+    let key = util::parse_issue_key_arg(&args.key)?;
+    let site = util::resolve_site(&config, &key, args.site.as_deref())?;
+    let base_url = site.base_url.trim_end_matches('/').to_string();
+
+    if args.web {
+        let web_url = format!("{base_url}/browse/{key}");
+        let _ = platform::open_url(&web_url);
+        println!("Opening {web_url} in browser");
+        return Ok(());
+    }
+
+    let client = JiraClient::from_config(&config, false)
+        .await
+        .map_err(|e| format!("Auth error: {e}"))?;
+
+    let issues = client
+        .bulk_fetch(&base_url, std::slice::from_ref(&key), None, &[], true)
+        .await?;
+    let issue = issues
+        .into_iter()
+        .next()
+        .ok_or_else(|| format!("Issue {key} not found"))?;
+    let detail = client.fetch_issue_detail(&base_url, &key).await.ok();
+
+    if args.json {
+        let ticket = crate::api::types::Ticket::from_bulk_fetch(
+            issue,
+            &site.name,
+            &base_url,
+            None,
+            &[],
+            false,
+        );
+        let issue_json = IssueJson::from_ticket(&ticket, &site.name);
+        let val = serde_json::json!({
+            "issue": issue_json,
+            "detail": detail
+        });
+        println!("{}", serde_json::to_string_pretty(&val).unwrap_or_default());
+        return Ok(());
+    }
+
+    let prio = issue
+        .fields
+        .priority
+        .as_ref()
+        .map(|p| p.name.as_str())
+        .unwrap_or("-");
+    let assignee = issue
+        .fields
+        .assignee
+        .as_ref()
+        .map(|a| a.display_name.as_str())
+        .unwrap_or("-");
+    let reporter = issue
+        .fields
+        .reporter
+        .as_ref()
+        .map(|r| r.display_name.as_str())
+        .unwrap_or("-");
+    let issue_type = &issue.fields.issue_type.name;
+    let url = format!("{base_url}/browse/{key}");
+
+    println!(
+        "{}  {}",
+        style::bold(&key),
+        style::bold(&issue.fields.summary)
+    );
+    println!(
+        "{} {}  {} {}  {} {}  {} {}  {} {}",
+        style::dim("Type:"),
+        style::cyan(issue_type),
+        style::dim("Status:"),
+        style::status_color(&issue.fields.status.name),
+        style::dim("Priority:"),
+        style::priority_color(prio),
+        style::dim("Assignee:"),
+        assignee,
+        style::dim("Reporter:"),
+        reporter,
+    );
+    println!("{} {}\n", style::dim("URL:"), style::blue(&url));
+
+    if let Some(ref parent) = issue.fields.parent {
+        println!(
+            "{} {} - {}",
+            style::dim("Parent:"),
+            style::bold(&parent.key),
+            parent.fields.summary
+        );
+    }
+
+    if let Some(ref labels) = issue.fields.labels {
+        if !labels.is_empty() {
+            println!("{} {}", style::dim("Labels:"), labels.join(", "));
+        }
+    }
+
+    if let Some(comps) = issue
+        .fields
+        .custom
+        .get("components")
+        .and_then(|c| c.as_array())
+    {
+        let comp_names: Vec<&str> = comps
+            .iter()
+            .filter_map(|c| c.get("name").and_then(|n| n.as_str()))
+            .collect();
+        if !comp_names.is_empty() {
+            println!("{} {}", style::dim("Components:"), comp_names.join(", "));
+        }
+    }
+
+    if let Some(vers) = issue
+        .fields
+        .custom
+        .get("fixVersions")
+        .and_then(|v| v.as_array())
+    {
+        let ver_names: Vec<&str> = vers
+            .iter()
+            .filter_map(|v| v.get("name").and_then(|n| n.as_str()))
+            .collect();
+        if !ver_names.is_empty() {
+            println!("{} {}", style::dim("Fix Versions:"), ver_names.join(", "));
+        }
+    }
+
+    if let Some(subtasks) = issue
+        .fields
+        .custom
+        .get("subtasks")
+        .and_then(|s| s.as_array())
+    {
+        if !subtasks.is_empty() {
+            println!(
+                "\n{}",
+                style::bold(&format!("SUBTASKS ({})", subtasks.len()))
+            );
+            for st in subtasks {
+                let st_key = st.get("key").and_then(|k| k.as_str()).unwrap_or("?");
+                let st_summary = st
+                    .get("fields")
+                    .and_then(|f| f.get("summary"))
+                    .and_then(|s| s.as_str())
+                    .unwrap_or("");
+                let st_status = st
+                    .get("fields")
+                    .and_then(|f| f.get("status"))
+                    .and_then(|s| s.get("name"))
+                    .and_then(|n| n.as_str())
+                    .unwrap_or("");
+                println!(
+                    "  • {} {} [{}]",
+                    style::bold(st_key),
+                    st_summary,
+                    style::status_color(st_status)
+                );
+            }
+        }
+    }
+
+    if let Some(links) = issue
+        .fields
+        .custom
+        .get("issuelinks")
+        .and_then(|l| l.as_array())
+    {
+        if !links.is_empty() {
+            println!(
+                "\n{}",
+                style::bold(&format!("ISSUE LINKS ({})", links.len()))
+            );
+            for link in links {
+                let link_type = link
+                    .get("type")
+                    .and_then(|t| t.get("name"))
+                    .and_then(|n| n.as_str())
+                    .unwrap_or("Relates");
+                if let Some(out) = link.get("outwardIssue") {
+                    let out_key = out.get("key").and_then(|k| k.as_str()).unwrap_or("?");
+                    let out_summary = out
+                        .get("fields")
+                        .and_then(|f| f.get("summary"))
+                        .and_then(|s| s.as_str())
+                        .unwrap_or("");
+                    println!(
+                        "  • {} {} ({})",
+                        style::bold(out_key),
+                        out_summary,
+                        style::dim(link_type)
+                    );
+                } else if let Some(inp) = link.get("inwardIssue") {
+                    let in_key = inp.get("key").and_then(|k| k.as_str()).unwrap_or("?");
+                    let in_summary = inp
+                        .get("fields")
+                        .and_then(|f| f.get("summary"))
+                        .and_then(|s| s.as_str())
+                        .unwrap_or("");
+                    println!(
+                        "  • {} {} ({})",
+                        style::bold(in_key),
+                        in_summary,
+                        style::dim(link_type)
+                    );
+                }
+            }
+        }
+    }
+
+    println!();
+    let desc = detail
+        .as_ref()
+        .and_then(|d| d.description.as_ref())
+        .map(crate::cli::adf_text::render_adf_text)
+        .unwrap_or_else(|| "No description provided.".to_string());
+
+    println!("{}\n{}\n", style::bold("DESCRIPTION"), desc.trim());
+
+    if args.comments
+        || detail
+            .as_ref()
+            .map(|d| d.comment.as_ref().map(|c| c.comments.len()).unwrap_or(0))
+            .unwrap_or(0)
+            > 0
+    {
+        if let Some(comm) = detail.as_ref().and_then(|d| d.comment.as_ref()) {
+            if !comm.comments.is_empty() {
+                println!(
+                    "{}",
+                    style::bold(&format!("COMMENTS ({})", comm.comments.len()))
+                );
+                for c in &comm.comments {
+                    let author = c
+                        .author
+                        .as_ref()
+                        .map(|a| a.display_name.as_str())
+                        .unwrap_or("Unknown");
+                    let body = c
+                        .body
+                        .as_ref()
+                        .map(crate::cli::adf_text::render_adf_text)
+                        .unwrap_or_default();
+                    println!("  {} {}:", style::cyan(author), style::dim("commented"));
+                    for line in body.lines() {
+                        println!("    {line}");
+                    }
+                    println!();
+                }
+            }
+        }
+    }
+
+    Ok(())
+}
+
+fn build_jql(args: &IssueListArgs) -> String {
+    if let Some(ref j) = args.jql {
+        return j.clone();
+    }
+    let mut parts = Vec::new();
+    if let Some(ref proj) = args.project {
+        parts.push(format!("project = \"{proj}\""));
+    }
+    if let Some(ref st) = args.status {
+        parts.push(format!("status = \"{st}\""));
+    }
+    if let Some(ref a) = args.assignee {
+        if a.eq_ignore_ascii_case("me") {
+            parts.push("assignee = currentUser()".to_string());
+        } else {
+            parts.push(format!("assignee = \"{a}\""));
+        }
+    } else if args.project.is_none() && args.status.is_none() {
+        parts.push("assignee = currentUser()".to_string());
+    }
+
+    if parts.is_empty() {
+        "ORDER BY updated DESC".to_string()
+    } else {
+        format!("{} ORDER BY updated DESC", parts.join(" AND "))
+    }
+}
+
+fn resolve_site<'a>(config: &'a Config, site_opt: Option<&str>) -> Result<&'a Site, String> {
+    util::resolve_site_for_command(config, site_opt)
+}
+
+fn urlencoding(s: &str) -> String {
+    s.replace(' ', "%20")
+        .replace('"', "%22")
+        .replace('=', "%3D")
+        .replace('&', "%26")
+}

+pub async fn run_create(args: IssueCreateArgs) -> Result<(), String> {
+    let config = Config::load().map_err(|e| format!("Config error: {e}"))?;
+    let site = resolve_site(&config, &args.project, args.site.as_deref())?;
+    let base_url = site.base_url.trim_end_matches('/').to_string();
+    let client = JiraClient::from_config(&config, false)
+        .await
+        .map_err(|e| format!("Auth error: {e}"))?;
+
+    let mut fields = json!({
+        "project": { "key": args.project },
+        "issuetype": { "name": args.issue_type },
+        "summary": args.summary,
+    });
+
+    let body_text = util::read_body_arg(args.body).unwrap_or_default();
+    if !body_text.trim().is_empty() {
+        let adf = crate::api::markdown::to_adf(&body_text, &[]);
+        fields["description"] = adf;
+    }
+
+    if let Some(labels_str) = args.labels {
+        let labels: Vec<String> = util::parse_labels_input(&labels_str);
+        if !labels.is_empty() {
+            fields["labels"] = json!(labels);
+        }
+    }
+
+    if let Some(prio) = args.priority {
+        if let Some(id) = client.resolve_priority_id(&base_url, &prio).await {
+            fields["priority"] = json!({ "id": id });
+        } else {
+            fields["priority"] = json!({ "name": prio });
+        }
+    }
+
+    if let Some(assignee_input) = args.assignee {
+        let account_id = if assignee_input.eq_ignore_ascii_case("me") {
+            client.current_user_account_id(&base_url).await?
+        } else {
+            assignee_input
+        };
+        fields["assignee"] = json!({ "accountId": account_id });
+    }
+
+    if let Some(parent) = args.parent {
+        fields["parent"] = json!({ "key": parent });
+    }
+
+    let key = client
+        .create_issue(&base_url, &fields)
+        .await
+        .map_err(|e| e.message)?;
+    let browse_url = format!("{base_url}/browse/{key}");
+
+    println!(
+        "{} Created issue {} ({})",
+        style::green("✓"),
+        style::bold(&key),
+        style::blue(&browse_url)
+    );
+    Ok(())
+}
+
+pub async fn run_edit(args: IssueEditArgs) -> Result<(), String> {
+    let config = Config::load().map_err(|e| format!("Config error: {e}"))?;
+    let key = parse_issue_key_arg(&args.key)?;
+    let site = resolve_site(&config, &key, args.site.as_deref())?;
+    let base_url = site.base_url.trim_end_matches('/').to_string();
+    let client = JiraClient::from_config(&config, false)
+        .await
+        .map_err(|e| format!("Auth error: {e}"))?;
+
+    let mut updated = false;
+
+    if let Some(summary) = args.summary {
+        client.update_summary(&base_url, &key, &summary).await?;
+        println!("{} Updated summary", style::green("✓"));
+        updated = true;
+    }
+
+    if let Some(body) = args.body {
+        client
+            .update_description(&base_url, &key, &body, &[])
+            .await?;
+        println!("{} Updated description", style::green("✓"));
+        updated = true;
+    }
+
+    if let Some(priority) = args.priority {
+        client.update_priority(&base_url, &key, &priority).await?;
+        println!("{} Updated priority to {}", style::green("✓"), priority);
+        updated = true;
+    }
+
+    if let Some(labels_str) = args.labels {
+        let labels = util::parse_labels_input(&labels_str);
+        client.update_labels(&base_url, &key, &labels).await?;
+        println!("{} Updated labels", style::green("✓"));
+        updated = true;
+    }
+
+    if let Some(assignee) = args.assignee {
+        if assignee.eq_ignore_ascii_case("none") || assignee.eq_ignore_ascii_case("unassign") {
+            client.unassign(&base_url, &key).await?;
+            println!("{} Removed assignee", style::green("✓"));
+        } else if assignee.eq_ignore_ascii_case("me") {
+            let me_id = client.current_user_account_id(&base_url).await?;
+            client.assign_to_account(&base_url, &key, &me_id).await?;
+            println!("{} Assigned to me", style::green("✓"));
+        } else {
+            client.assign_to_account(&base_url, &key, &assignee).await?;
+            println!("{} Assigned to {}", style::green("✓"), assignee);
+        }
+        updated = true;
+    }
+
+    if !updated {
+        println!(
+            "{}",
+            style::dim(
+                "No changes specified. Use --summary, --body, --priority, --labels, or --assignee."
+            )
+        );
+    } else {
+        println!("{} Updated {}", style::green("✓"), style::bold(&key));
+    }
+    Ok(())
+}
+
+pub async fn run_transition(args: IssueTransitionArgs) -> Result<(), String> {
+    let config = Config::load().map_err(|e| format!("Config error: {e}"))?;
+    let key = parse_issue_key_arg(&args.key)?;
+    let site = resolve_site(&config, &key, args.site.as_deref())?;
+    let base_url = site.base_url.trim_end_matches('/').to_string();
+    let client = JiraClient::from_config(&config, false)
+        .await
+        .map_err(|e| format!("Auth error: {e}"))?;
+
+    if args.list || args.to.is_none() {
+        let transitions =
+            crate::operations::transition::list_transitions_with_fields(&client, &base_url, &key)
+                .await?;
+        if args.json {
+            println!(
+                "{}",
+                serde_json::to_string_pretty(&transitions).unwrap_or_default()
+            );
+            return Ok(());
+        }
+
+        println!("Available workflow transitions for {}:", style::bold(&key));
+        if transitions.is_empty() {
+            println!(
+                "{}",
+                style::dim("  No transitions available from current status.")
+            );
+            return Ok(());
+        }
+
+        for t in &transitions {
+            let to_part = if t.to_status.is_empty() {
+                String::new()
+            } else {
+                format!(" → {}", style::status_color(&t.to_status))
+            };
+            println!(
+                "  • {} (id: {}){}",
+                style::bold(&t.name),
+                style::dim(&t.id),
+                to_part
+            );
+            if !t.required_fields.is_empty() {
+                println!("    {}", style::yellow("Required fields / rules:"));
+                for f in &t.required_fields {
+                    if !f.options.is_empty() {
+                        println!(
+                            "      - {} ({}) [options: {}]",
+                            style::bold(&f.name),
+                            style::dim(&f.id),
+                            f.options.join(", ")
+                        );
+                    } else {
+                        println!("      - {} ({})", style::bold(&f.name), style::dim(&f.id));
+                    }
+                }
+            }
+        }
+        println!(
+            "\nRun 'tick issue transition {} --to <status>' to apply.",
+            key
+        );
+        return Ok(());
+    }
+
+    let target = args.to.as_deref().unwrap();
+    let mut extra_fields: HashMap<String, serde_json::Value> = HashMap::new();
+
+    if let Some(ref json_str) = args.fields_json {
+        let parsed: HashMap<String, serde_json::Value> = serde_json::from_str(json_str)
+            .map_err(|e| format!("Invalid JSON passed to --fields: {e}"))?;
+        for (k, v) in parsed {
+            extra_fields.insert(k, v);
+        }
+    }
+
+    for f in &args.field {
+        let parts: Vec<&str> = f.splitn(2, '=').collect();
+        if parts.len() != 2 {
+            return Err(format!("Invalid -F format '{f}': expected key=value"));
+        }
+        let k = parts[0].trim().to_string();
+        let raw_val = parts[1].trim();
+        let v = serde_json::from_str(raw_val)
+            .unwrap_or_else(|_| serde_json::Value::String(raw_val.to_string()));
+        extra_fields.insert(k, v);
+    }
+
+    let options = crate::operations::transition::TransitionOptions {
+        resolution: args.resolution.as_deref(),
+        extra_fields: Some(&extra_fields),
+        comment: args.comment.as_deref(),
+    };
+
+    crate::operations::transition::apply_transition_by_name_with_options(
+        &client, &base_url, &key, target, &options,
+    )
+    .await
+    .map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
+
+    println!(
+        "{} Transitioned {} to {}",
+        style::green("✓"),
+        style::bold(&key),
+        style::cyan(target)
+    );
+    Ok(())
+}
+
+pub async fn run_close(args: IssueCloseArgs) -> Result<(), String> {
+    let config = Config::load().map_err(|e| format!("Config error: {e}"))?;
+    let key = parse_issue_key_arg(&args.key)?;
+    let site = resolve_site(&config, &key, args.site.as_deref())?;
+    let base_url = site.base_url.trim_end_matches('/').to_string();
+    let client = JiraClient::from_config(&config, false)
+        .await
+        .map_err(|e| format!("Auth error: {e}"))?;
+
+    let close_targets = ["Done", "Closed", "Resolved", "Complete", "Finish"];
+    let mut transitioned = false;
+    let options = crate::operations::transition::TransitionOptions {
+        resolution: args.resolution.as_deref(),
+        extra_fields: None,
+        comment: args.comment.as_deref(),
+    };
+    for target in close_targets {
+        if crate::operations::transition::apply_transition_by_name_with_options(
+            &client, &base_url, &key, target, &options,
+        )
+        .await
+        .is_ok()
+        {
+            transitioned = true;
+            println!(
+                "{} Closed {} as {}",
+                style::green("✓"),
+                style::bold(&key),
+                style::status_color(target)
+            );
+            break;
+        }
+    }
+
+    if !transitioned {
+        return Err(format!(
+            "Could not find a valid transition to close issue {key}. Use 'tick issue transition {key} --list' to inspect available transitions."
+        ));
+    }
+
+    Ok(())
+}
+
+pub async fn run_reopen(args: IssueReopenArgs) -> Result<(), String> {
+    let config = Config::load().map_err(|e| format!("Config error: {e}"))?;
+    let key = parse_issue_key_arg(&args.key)?;
+    let site = resolve_site(&config, &key, args.site.as_deref())?;
+    let base_url = site.base_url.trim_end_matches('/').to_string();
+    let client = JiraClient::from_config(&config, false)
+        .await
+        .map_err(|e| format!("Auth error: {e}"))?;
+
+    let reopen_targets = ["Reopened", "Reopen", "Open", "To Do", "In Progress"];
+    let mut transitioned = false;
+    for target in reopen_targets {
+        if crate::operations::transition::apply_transition_by_name(&client, &base_url, &key, target)
+            .await
+            .is_ok()
+        {
+            transitioned = true;
+            println!(
+                "{} Reopened {} as {}",
+                style::green("✓"),
+                style::bold(&key),
+                style::cyan(target)
+            );
+            break;
+        }
+    }
+
+    if !transitioned {
+        return Err(format!(
+            "Could not find a valid transition to reopen issue {key}. Use 'tick issue transition {key} --to <status>'."
+        ));
+    }
+
+    if let Some(comment) = args.comment {
+        if !comment.trim().is_empty() {
+            client
+                .add_comment_with_attachments(&base_url, &key, &comment, &[], &[])
+                .await?;
+            println!("{} Added reopen comment", style::green("✓"));
+        }
+    }
+
+    Ok(())
+}
+
+pub async fn run_assign(args: IssueAssignArgs) -> Result<(), String> {
+    let config = Config::load().map_err(|e| format!("Config error: {e}"))?;
+    let key = parse_issue_key_arg(&args.key)?;
+    let site = resolve_site(&config, &key, args.site.as_deref())?;
+    let base_url = site.base_url.trim_end_matches('/').to_string();
+    let client = JiraClient::from_config(&config, false)
+        .await
+        .map_err(|e| format!("Auth error: {e}"))?;
+
+    if args.unassign || args.to.as_deref() == Some("none") || args.to.as_deref() == Some("unassign")
+    {
+        client.unassign(&base_url, &key).await?;
+        println!("{} Unassigned {}", style::green("✓"), style::bold(&key));
+    } else if args.me || args.to.as_deref() == Some("me") {
+        let me_id = client.current_user_account_id(&base_url).await?;
+        client.assign_to_account(&base_url, &key, &me_id).await?;
+        println!(
+            "{} Assigned {} to {}",
+            style::green("✓"),
+            style::bold(&key),
+            style::cyan("me")
+        );
+    } else if let Some(target) = args.to {
+        client.assign_to_account(&base_url, &key, &target).await?;
+        println!(
+            "{} Assigned {} to {}",
+            style::green("✓"),
+            style::bold(&key),
+            style::cyan(&target)
+        );
+    } else {
+        return Err("Specify --to <account_id|me|none>, --me, or --unassign".to_string());
+    }
+
+    Ok(())
+}
+
+pub async fn run_delete(args: IssueDeleteArgs) -> Result<(), String> {
+    let config = Config::load().map_err(|e| format!("Config error: {e}"))?;
+    let key = parse_issue_key_arg(&args.key)?;
+    let site = resolve_site(&config, &key, args.site.as_deref())?;
+    let base_url = site.base_url.trim_end_matches('/').to_string();
+    let client = JiraClient::from_config(&config, false)
+        .await
+        .map_err(|e| format!("Auth error: {e}"))?;
+
+    if !args.yes {
+        return Err(format!(
+            "Deleting issue {key} is irreversible. Run with '--yes' to confirm deletion."
+        ));
+    }
+
+    client.delete_issue(&base_url, &key).await?;
+    println!("{} Deleted issue {}", style::green("✓"), style::bold(&key));
+    Ok(())
+}

+//! `tick issue` commands modeled after `gh issue`.
+
+pub mod extra;
+pub mod list;
+pub mod manage;
+
+use clap::{Parser, Subcommand};
+
+#[derive(Parser, Debug)]
+pub struct IssueArgs {
+    #[command(subcommand)]
+    pub command: IssueCommand,
+}
+
+#[derive(Subcommand, Debug)]
+pub enum IssueCommand {
+    /// List issues matching query or assigned to you
+    #[command(name = "list", alias = "ls")]
+    List(list::IssueListArgs),
+
+    /// View issue details, comments, and links
+    #[command(name = "view")]
+    View(list::IssueViewArgs),
+
+    /// Create a new issue
+    #[command(name = "create", alias = "new")]
+    Create(manage::IssueCreateArgs),
+
+    /// Edit an existing issue
+    #[command(name = "edit")]
+    Edit(manage::IssueEditArgs),
+
+    /// Close an issue
+    #[command(name = "close")]
+    Close(manage::IssueCloseArgs),
+
+    /// Reopen an issue
+    #[command(name = "reopen")]
+    Reopen(manage::IssueReopenArgs),
+
+    /// Transition issue workflow status
+    #[command(name = "transition", alias = "move")]
+    Transition(manage::IssueTransitionArgs),
+
+    /// Assign an issue to a user or clear assignee
+    #[command(name = "assign")]
+    Assign(manage::IssueAssignArgs),
+
+    /// Delete an issue
+    #[command(name = "delete", alias = "rm")]
+    Delete(manage::IssueDeleteArgs),
+
+    /// Add, list, or delete comments on an issue
+    #[command(name = "comment")]
+    Comment(extra::CommentArgs),
+
+    /// Log, list, or delete worklog entries on an issue
+    #[command(name = "worklog")]
+    Worklog(extra::WorklogArgs),
+
+    /// Link issues together or list relations
+    #[command(name = "link")]
+    Link(extra::LinkArgs),
+
+    /// Add current user as watcher
+    #[command(name = "watch")]
+    Watch(extra::WatchArgs),
+
+    /// Remove current user from watchers
+    #[command(name = "unwatch")]
+    Unwatch(extra::WatchArgs),
+}
+
+pub async fn run(cmd: IssueCommand) -> Result<(), String> {
+    match cmd {
+        IssueCommand::List(args) => list::run_list(args).await,
+        IssueCommand::View(args) => list::run_view(args).await,
+        IssueCommand::Create(args) => manage::run_create(args).await,
+        IssueCommand::Edit(args) => manage::run_edit(args).await,
+        IssueCommand::Close(args) => manage::run_close(args).await,
+        IssueCommand::Reopen(args) => manage::run_reopen(args).await,
+        IssueCommand::Transition(args) => manage::run_transition(args).await,
+        IssueCommand::Assign(args) => manage::run_assign(args).await,
+        IssueCommand::Delete(args) => manage::run_delete(args).await,
+        IssueCommand::Comment(args) => extra::run_comment(args).await,
+        IssueCommand::Worklog(args) => extra::run_worklog(args).await,
+        IssueCommand::Link(args) => extra::run_link(args).await,
+        IssueCommand::Watch(args) => extra::run_watch(args, false).await,
+        IssueCommand::Unwatch(args) => extra::run_watch(args, true).await,
+    }
+}

+
+pub async fn run(cmd: PageCommand) -> Result<(), String> {
+    match cmd {
+        PageCommand::List {
+            space_id,
+            limit,
+            site,
+            json,
+        } => run_list(&space_id, limit, site.as_deref(), json).await,
+        PageCommand::View {
+            page_id,
+            raw,
+            web,
+            site,
+            json,
+        } => run_view(&page_id, raw, web, site.as_deref(), json).await,
+        PageCommand::Create {
+            space,
+            title,
+            body,
+            parent,
+            site,
+        } => run_create(&space, &title, body, parent.as_deref(), site.as_deref()).await,
+        PageCommand::Edit {
+            page_id,
+            title,
+            body,
+            site,
+        } => run_edit(&page_id, &title, body, site.as_deref()).await,
+        PageCommand::Delete { page_id, yes, site } => {
+            run_delete(&page_id, yes, site.as_deref()).await
+        }
+        PageCommand::Comment {
+            page_id,
+            body,
+            site,
+            json,
+        } => run_comment(&page_id, body, site.as_deref(), json).await,
+        PageCommand::History {
+            page_id,
+            site,
+            json,
+        } => run_history(&page_id, site.as_deref(), json).await,
+        PageCommand::Attachments {
+            page_id,
+            site,
+            json,
+        } => run_attachments(&page_id, site.as_deref(), json).await,
+    }
+}
+
+async fn run_list(
+    space_id: &str,
+    limit: Option<u32>,
+    site_opt: Option<&str>,
+    json: bool,
+) -> Result<(), String> {
+    let (client, site) = resolve_client_and_site(site_opt).await?;
+    let pages = client
+        .confluence_list_pages_in_space(&site.base_url, space_id, limit)
+        .await?;
+
+    if json {
+        println!(
+            "{}",
+            serde_json::to_string_pretty(&pages).unwrap_or_default()
+        );
+        return Ok(());
+    }
+
+    if pages.is_empty() {
+        println!("{}", style::dim("No pages found in space."));
+        return Ok(());
+    }
+
+    let headers = ["ID", "TITLE", "STATUS"];
+    let rows: Vec<Vec<String>> = pages
+        .into_iter()
+        .map(|p| vec![p.id, truncate(&p.title, 50), p.status])
+        .collect();
+
+    format::print_table(&headers, &rows);
+    Ok(())
+}
+
+async fn run_view(
+    page_id: &str,
+    raw: bool,
+    web: bool,
+    site_opt: Option<&str>,
+    json: bool,
+) -> Result<(), String> {
+    let (client, site) = resolve_client_and_site(site_opt).await?;
+    let page = client.confluence_get_page(&site.base_url, page_id).await?;
+
+    if web {
+        if let Some(link) = page.links.as_ref().and_then(|l| l.webui.as_deref()) {
+            let full_url = format!("{}{}", site.base_url.trim_end_matches('/'), link);
+            let _ = platform::open_url(&full_url);
+            println!("Opening {full_url} in browser");
+            return Ok(());
+        }
+    }
+
+    if json {
+        println!(
+            "{}",
+            serde_json::to_string_pretty(&page).unwrap_or_default()
+        );
+        return Ok(());
+    }
+
+    let version_num = page.version.as_ref().map(|v| v.number).unwrap_or(1);
+
+    println!(
+        "{}  {}",
+        style::bold(&page.title),
+        style::dim(&format!("(v{version_num})"))
+    );
+    println!("{} {}", style::dim("Page ID:"), page.id);
+    println!("{} {}", style::dim("Status:"), page.status);
+    if let Some(link) = page.links.as_ref().and_then(|l| l.webui.as_deref()) {
+        println!(
+            "{} {}\n",
+            style::dim("URL:"),
+            style::blue(&format!("{}{}", site.base_url.trim_end_matches('/'), link))
+        );
+    } else {
+        println!();
+    }
+
+    let body_storage = page
+        .body
+        .as_ref()
+        .and_then(|b| b.storage.as_ref())
+        .map(|s| s.value.as_str())
+        .unwrap_or("");
+
+    if raw {
+        println!("{body_storage}");
+    } else {
+        println!("{}", storage_format_to_plain_text(body_storage));
+    }
+
+    Ok(())
+}
+
+async fn run_create(
+    space_id: &str,
+    title: &str,
+    body_opt: Option<String>,
+    parent_id: Option<&str>,
+    site_opt: Option<&str>,
+) -> Result<(), String> {
+    let (client, site) = resolve_client_and_site(site_opt).await?;
+    let body_text = util::read_body_arg(body_opt)?;
+    let storage_html = crate::api::confluence::plain_text_to_storage_format(&body_text);
+
+    let page = client
+        .confluence_create_page(&site.base_url, space_id, title, &storage_html, parent_id)
+        .await?;
+
+    println!(
+        "{} Created page '{}' (ID: {})",
+        style::green("✓"),
+        style::bold(&page.title),
+        style::bold(&page.id)
+    );
+    Ok(())
+}
+
+async fn run_edit(
+    page_id: &str,
+    title: &str,
+    body_opt: Option<String>,
+    site_opt: Option<&str>,
+) -> Result<(), String> {
+    let (client, site) = resolve_client_and_site(site_opt).await?;
+    let existing = client.confluence_get_page(&site.base_url, page_id).await?;
+    let current_version = existing.version.as_ref().map(|v| v.number).unwrap_or(1);
+
+    let storage_html = if let Some(b) = body_opt {
+        crate::api::confluence::plain_text_to_storage_format(&b)
+    } else {
+        existing
+            .body
+            .as_ref()
+            .and_then(|b| b.storage.as_ref())
+            .map(|s| s.value.clone())
+            .unwrap_or_default()
+    };
+
+    let page = client
+        .confluence_update_page(
+            &site.base_url,
+            page_id,
+            title,
+            &storage_html,
+            current_version + 1,
+        )
+        .await?;
+
+    println!(
+        "{} Updated page '{}' to version {}",
+        style::green("✓"),
+        style::bold(&page.title),
+        current_version + 1
+    );
+    Ok(())
+}
+
+async fn run_delete(page_id: &str, yes: bool, site_opt: Option<&str>) -> Result<(), String> {
+    if !yes {
+        return Err(format!(
+            "Deleting page {page_id} is irreversible. Run with '--yes' to confirm deletion."
+        ));
+    }
+    let (client, site) = resolve_client_and_site(site_opt).await?;
+    client
+        .confluence_delete_page(&site.base_url, page_id)
+        .await?;
+    println!("{} Deleted page {page_id}", style::green("✓"));
+    Ok(())
+}
+
+async fn run_comment(
+    page_id: &str,
+    body_opt: Option<String>,
+    site_opt: Option<&str>,
+    json: bool,
+) -> Result<(), String> {
+    let (client, site) = resolve_client_and_site(site_opt).await?;
+
+    if let Some(body) = body_opt {
+        let storage_html = crate::api::confluence::plain_text_to_storage_format(&body);
+        let comment = client
+            .confluence_add_comment(&site.base_url, page_id, &storage_html)
+            .await?;
+        println!(
+            "{} Added comment (ID: {}) to page {page_id}",
+            style::green("✓"),
+            comment.id
+        );
+        return Ok(());
+    }
+
+    let comments = client
+        .confluence_list_comments(&site.base_url, page_id)
+        .await?;
+
+    if json {
+        println!(
+            "{}",
+            serde_json::to_string_pretty(&comments).unwrap_or_default()
+        );
+        return Ok(());
+    }
+
+    if comments.is_empty() {
+        println!("{}", style::dim("No comments on page."));
+        return Ok(());
+    }
+
+    for c in &comments {
+        let label = c.title.as_deref().unwrap_or("Comment");
+        let body = c
+            .body
+            .as_ref()
+            .and_then(|b| b.storage.as_ref())
+            .map(|s| storage_format_to_plain_text(&s.value))
+            .unwrap_or_default();
+        println!(
+            "{} {}:",
+            style::bold(label),
+            style::dim(&format!("[id: {}]", c.id))
+        );
+        for line in body.lines() {
+            println!("  {line}");
+        }
+        println!();
+    }
+
+    Ok(())
+}
+
+async fn run_history(page_id: &str, site_opt: Option<&str>, json: bool) -> Result<(), String> {
+    let (client, site) = resolve_client_and_site(site_opt).await?;
+    let versions = client
+        .confluence_list_page_versions(&site.base_url, page_id)
+        .await?;
+
+    if json {
+        println!(
+            "{}",
+            serde_json::to_string_pretty(&versions).unwrap_or_default()
+        );
+        return Ok(());
+    }
+
+    if versions.is_empty() {
+        println!("{}", style::dim("No version history found."));
+        return Ok(());
+    }
+
+    let headers = ["VERSION", "BY", "CREATED", "MESSAGE"];
+    let rows: Vec<Vec<String>> = versions
+        .into_iter()
+        .map(|v| {
+            let num = v
+                .get("number")
+                .and_then(|n| n.as_u64())
+                .unwrap_or(0)
+                .to_string();
+            let author = v
+                .get("by")
+                .and_then(|b| b.get("displayName"))
+                .and_then(|d| d.as_str())
+                .unwrap_or("Unknown")
+                .to_string();
+            let created = v
+                .get("createdAt")
+                .and_then(|c| c.as_str())
+                .unwrap_or("")
+                .to_string();
+            let msg = v
+                .get("message")
+                .and_then(|m| m.as_str())
+                .unwrap_or("")
+                .to_string();
+            vec![num, author, created, msg]
+        })
+        .collect();
+
+    format::print_table(&headers, &rows);
+    Ok(())
+}
+
+async fn run_attachments(page_id: &str, site_opt: Option<&str>, json: bool) -> Result<(), String> {
+    let (client, site) = resolve_client_and_site(site_opt).await?;
+    let attachments = client
+        .confluence_list_attachments(&site.base_url, page_id)
+        .await?;
+
+    if json {
+        println!(
+            "{}",
+            serde_json::to_string_pretty(&attachments).unwrap_or_default()
+        );
+        return Ok(());
+    }
+
+    if attachments.is_empty() {
+        println!("{}", style::dim("No attachments on page."));
+        return Ok(());
+    }
+
+    let headers = ["ID", "TITLE", "MEDIA TYPE", "SIZE"];
+    let rows: Vec<Vec<String>> = attachments
+        .into_iter()
+        .map(|a| {
+            let id = a
+                .get("id")
+                .and_then(|v| v.as_str())
+                .unwrap_or("?")
+                .to_string();
+            let title = a
+                .get("title")
+                .and_then(|t| t.as_str())
+                .unwrap_or("?")
+                .to_string();
+            let media = a
+                .get("mediaType")
+                .and_then(|m| m.as_str())
+                .unwrap_or("")
+                .to_string();
+            let size = a
+                .get("fileSize")
+                .and_then(|s| s.as_u64())
+                .map(|b| format!("{b} B"))
+                .unwrap_or_default();
+            vec![id, truncate(&title, 40), media, size]
+        })
+        .collect();
+
+    format::print_table(&headers, &rows);
+    Ok(())
+}
+
+async fn resolve_client_and_site(
+    site_opt: Option<&str>,
+) -> Result<(JiraClient, crate::config::Site), String> {
+    let config = Config::load().map_err(|e| format!("Config error: {e}"))?;
+    let site = util::resolve_site_for_command(&config, site_opt)?.clone();
+    let client = JiraClient::from_config(&config, false)
+        .await
+        .map_err(|e| format!("Auth error: {e}"))?;
+    Ok((client, site))
+}

@@ -0,0 +1,215 @@
+use crate::api::JiraClient;
+use crate::cli::format::{self, truncate};
+use crate::cli::style;
+use crate::config::Config;
+use clap::{Parser, Subcommand};
+
+#[derive(Parser, Debug)]
+pub struct SearchArgs {
+    #[command(subcommand)]
+    pub target: Option<SearchTarget>,
+
+    /// Query or JQL when run directly without subcommand (e.g. `tick search "error"`)
+    #[arg(required = false)]
+    pub query: Option<String>,
+
+    /// Limit to specific configured site
+    #[arg(long)]
+    pub site: Option<String>,
+
+    /// Maximum results
+    #[arg(short = 'L', long, default_value = "30")]
+    pub limit: u32,
+
+    /// Output JSON
+    #[arg(long)]
+    pub json: bool,
+}
+
+#[derive(Subcommand, Debug)]
+pub enum SearchTarget {
+    /// Search Jira issues (by JQL or text)
+    Issues {
+        query: String,
+        #[arg(long)]
+        site: Option<String>,
+        #[arg(short = 'L', long, default_value = "30")]
+        limit: u32,
+        #[arg(long)]
+        json: bool,
+    },
+    /// Search Confluence pages (by text or CQL)
+    Pages {
+        query: String,
+        #[arg(long)]
+        site: Option<String>,
+        #[arg(short = 'L', long, default_value = "25")]
+        limit: u32,
+        #[arg(long)]
+        json: bool,
+    },
+}
+
+pub async fn run(args: SearchArgs) -> Result<(), String> {
+    match args.target {
+        Some(SearchTarget::Issues {
+            query,
+            site,
+            limit,
+            json,
+        }) => search_issues(&query, site.as_deref(), limit, json).await,
+        Some(SearchTarget::Pages {
+            query,
+            site,
+            limit,
+            json,
+        }) => search_pages(&query, site.as_deref(), limit, json).await,
+        None => {
+            let q = args.query.ok_or_else(|| {
+                "Search query required. Example: tick search issues 'text ~ \"crash\"'".to_string()
+            })?;
+            search_issues(&q, args.site.as_deref(), args.limit, args.json).await
+        }
+    }
+}
+
+async fn search_issues(
+    query: &str,
+    site_opt: Option<&str>,
+    limit: u32,
+    json: bool,
+) -> Result<(), String> {
+    let config = Config::load().map_err(|e| format!("Config error: {e}"))?;
+    let site = if let Some(name) = site_opt {
+        config
+            .sites
+            .iter()
+            .find(|s| s.name.eq_ignore_ascii_case(name))
+            .ok_or_else(|| format!("Unknown site '{name}'"))?
+    } else {
+        config
+            .sites
+            .first()
+            .ok_or_else(|| "No sites configured in tick config".to_string())?
+    };
+
+    let base_url = site.base_url.trim_end_matches('/').to_string();
+    let client = JiraClient::from_config(&config, false)
+        .await
+        .map_err(|e| format!("Auth error: {e}"))?;
+
+    // If query contains '=', 'ORDER BY', or 'AND', treat as full JQL, else text search
+    let jql = if query.contains('=') || query.to_uppercase().contains("ORDER BY") {
+        query.to_string()
+    } else {
+        format!("text ~ \"{query}\" ORDER BY updated DESC")
+    };
+
+    let mut progress = None;
+    let ids = client
+        .search_jql(&base_url, &jql, limit, &mut progress)
+        .await?;
+    let issues = client.bulk_fetch(&base_url, &ids, None, &[], false).await?;
+
+    if json {
+        let tickets: Vec<crate::cli::util::IssueJson> = issues
+            .into_iter()
+            .map(|i| {
+                let ticket = crate::api::types::Ticket::from_bulk_fetch(
+                    i,
+                    &site.name,
+                    &base_url,
+                    None,
+                    &[],
+                    false,
+                );
+                crate::cli::util::IssueJson::from_ticket(&ticket, &site.name)
+            })
+            .collect();
+        println!(
+            "{}",
+            serde_json::to_string_pretty(&tickets).unwrap_or_default()
+        );
+        return Ok(());
+    }
+
+    if issues.is_empty() {
+        println!("{}", style::dim("No matching issues found."));
+        return Ok(());
+    }
+
+    let headers = ["KEY", "STATUS", "SUMMARY", "ASSIGNEE"];
+    let rows: Vec<Vec<String>> = issues
+        .into_iter()
+        .map(|i| {
+            let key = i.key;
+            let status = i.fields.status.name;
+            let summary = i.fields.summary;
+            let assignee = i
+                .fields
+                .assignee
+                .map(|a| a.display_name)
+                .unwrap_or_else(|| "Unassigned".into());
+            vec![
+                key,
+                style::status_color(&status),
+                truncate(&summary, 45),
+                assignee,
+            ]
+        })
+        .collect();
+
+    format::print_table(&headers, &rows);
+    Ok(())
+}
+
+async fn search_pages(
+    query: &str,
+    site_opt: Option<&str>,
+    limit: u32,
+    json: bool,
+) -> Result<(), String> {
+    let config = Config::load().map_err(|e| format!("Config error: {e}"))?;
+    let site = if let Some(name) = site_opt {
+        config
+            .sites
+            .iter()
+            .find(|s| s.name.eq_ignore_ascii_case(name))
+            .ok_or_else(|| format!("Unknown site '{name}'"))?
+    } else {
+        config
+            .sites
+            .first()
+            .ok_or_else(|| "No sites configured in tick config".to_string())?
+    };
+
+    let client = JiraClient::from_config(&config, false)
+        .await
+        .map_err(|e| format!("Auth error: {e}"))?;
+
+    let pages = client
+        .confluence_search_pages(&site.base_url, query, Some(limit))
+        .await?;
+
+    if json {
+        println!(
+            "{}",
+            serde_json::to_string_pretty(&pages).unwrap_or_default()
+        );
+        return Ok(());
+    }
+
+    if pages.is_empty() {
+        println!("{}", style::dim("No matching Confluence pages found."));
+        return Ok(());
+    }
+
+    let headers = ["ID", "TITLE", "STATUS"];
+    let rows: Vec<Vec<String>> = pages
+        .into_iter()
+        .map(|p| vec![p.id, truncate(&p.title, 50), p.status])
+        .collect();
+
+    format::print_table(&headers, &rows);
+    Ok(())
+}

+use crate::api::JiraClient;

+    pub command: SpaceCommand,
+}
+
+#[derive(Subcommand, Debug)]
+pub enum SpaceCommand {
+    /// List Confluence spaces
+    #[command(name = "list", alias = "ls")]
+    List {
+        #[arg(short = 'L', long)]
+        limit: Option<u32>,
+        #[arg(long)]
+        site: Option<String>,
+        #[arg(long)]
+        json: bool,

+    #[command(name = "view")]

+        #[arg(short = 'w', long)]

+        #[arg(long)]
+        site: Option<String>,
+        #[arg(long)]
+        json: bool,
+    },
+}
+
+pub async fn run(cmd: SpaceCommand) -> Result<(), String> {
+    match cmd {
+        SpaceCommand::List { limit, site, json } => run_list(limit, site.as_deref(), json).await,
+        SpaceCommand::View {
+            space_key_or_id,
+            web,
+            site,
+            json,
+        } => run_view(&space_key_or_id, web, site.as_deref(), json).await,
+    }
+}
+
+async fn run_list(limit: Option<u32>, site_opt: Option<&str>, json: bool) -> Result<(), String> {

+    let site = resolve_site(&config, site_opt)?;
+    let base_url = site.base_url.trim_end_matches('/').to_string();
+    let client = JiraClient::from_config(&config, false)
+        .await
+        .map_err(|e| format!("Auth error: {e}"))?;
+
+    let spaces = client.confluence_list_spaces(&base_url, limit).await?;
+
+    if json {
+        println!(
+            "{}",
+            serde_json::to_string_pretty(&spaces).unwrap_or_default()
+        );
+        return Ok(());
+    }
+
+    if spaces.is_empty() {
+        println!("{}", style::dim("No spaces found."));
+        return Ok(());
+    }
+
+    let headers = ["ID", "KEY", "NAME", "TYPE", "STATUS"];
+    let rows: Vec<Vec<String>> = spaces
+        .into_iter()
+        .map(|s| vec![s.id, s.key, truncate(&s.name, 35), s.space_type, s.status])
+        .collect();
+
+    format::print_table(&headers, &rows);

+
+async fn run_view(
+    space_key_or_id: &str,
+    web: bool,
+    site_opt: Option<&str>,
+    json: bool,
+) -> Result<(), String> {
+    let config = Config::load().map_err(|e| format!("Config error: {e}"))?;
+    let site = resolve_site(&config, site_opt)?;
+    let base_url = site.base_url.trim_end_matches('/').to_string();
+
+    if web {
+        let web_url = format!("{base_url}/wiki/spaces/{space_key_or_id}");
+        let _ = platform::open_url(&web_url);
+        println!("Opening {web_url} in browser");
+        return Ok(());
+    }
+
+    let client = JiraClient::from_config(&config, false)
+        .await
+        .map_err(|e| format!("Auth error: {e}"))?;
+
+    let space = client
+        .confluence_get_space(&base_url, space_key_or_id)
+        .await?;
+
+    if json {
+        println!(
+            "{}",
+            serde_json::to_string_pretty(&space).unwrap_or_default()
+        );
+        return Ok(());
+    }

+    println!("{}  {}", style::bold(&space.key), style::bold(&space.name));
+    println!("{} {}", style::dim("Space ID:"), space.id);
+    println!("{} {}", style::dim("Type:"), style::cyan(&space.space_type));

+    if let Some(ref hp) = space.homepage_id {

+    }
+    println!(
+        "{} {}\n",
+        style::dim("URL:"),
+        style::blue(&format!("{base_url}/wiki/spaces/{}", space.key))
+    );
+
+    Ok(())
+}
+
+fn resolve_site<'a>(
+    config: &'a Config,
+    site_opt: Option<&str>,
+) -> Result<&'a crate::config::Site, String> {
+    crate::cli::util::resolve_site_for_command(config, site_opt)
+}

@@ -0,0 +1,93 @@
+use std::io::IsTerminal;
+
+fn use_color() -> bool {
+    std::io::stdout().is_terminal() && std::env::var("NO_COLOR").is_err()
+}
+
+pub fn bold(s: &str) -> String {
+    if use_color() {
+        format!("\x1b[1m{s}\x1b[0m")
+    } else {
+        s.to_string()
+    }
+}
+
+pub fn dim(s: &str) -> String {
+    if use_color() {
+        format!("\x1b[2m{s}\x1b[0m")
+    } else {
+        s.to_string()
+    }
+}
+
+pub fn green(s: &str) -> String {
+    if use_color() {
+        format!("\x1b[32m{s}\x1b[0m")
+    } else {
+        s.to_string()
+    }
+}
+
+pub fn yellow(s: &str) -> String {
+    if use_color() {
+        format!("\x1b[33m{s}\x1b[0m")
+    } else {
+        s.to_string()
+    }
+}
+
+pub fn blue(s: &str) -> String {
+    if use_color() {
+        format!("\x1b[34m{s}\x1b[0m")
+    } else {
+        s.to_string()
+    }
+}
+
+pub fn magenta(s: &str) -> String {
+    if use_color() {
+        format!("\x1b[35m{s}\x1b[0m")
+    } else {
+        s.to_string()
+    }
+}
+
+pub fn cyan(s: &str) -> String {
+    if use_color() {
+        format!("\x1b[36m{s}\x1b[0m")
+    } else {
+        s.to_string()
+    }
+}
+
+pub fn red(s: &str) -> String {
+    if use_color() {
+        format!("\x1b[31m{s}\x1b[0m")
+    } else {
+        s.to_string()
+    }
+}
+
+pub fn status_color(status: &str) -> String {
+    let lower = status.to_lowercase();
+    if lower.contains("done") || lower.contains("closed") || lower.contains("resolved") {
+        green(status)
+    } else if lower.contains("progress") || lower.contains("review") || lower.contains("testing") {
+        yellow(status)
+    } else if lower.contains("block") || lower.contains("cancel") || lower.contains("wont") {
+        red(status)
+    } else {
+        blue(status)
+    }
+}
+
+pub fn priority_color(priority: &str) -> String {
+    match priority.to_lowercase().as_str() {
+        "highest" | "blocker" | "p1" => red(priority),
+        "high" | "critical" | "p2" => yellow(priority),
+        "medium" | "major" | "p3" => cyan(priority),
+        "low" | "minor" | "p4" => dim(priority),
+        "lowest" | "trivial" | "p5" => dim(priority),
+        _ => priority.to_string(),
+    }
+}

+    let base_url = site.base_url.trim_end_matches('/').to_string();

+        .await
+        .map_err(|e| format!("Auth error: {e}"))?;

+

+

+                .and_then(|v| v.as_str())

+            let name = u
+                .get("displayName")
+                .and_then(|v| v.as_str())
+                .unwrap_or("?")
+                .to_string();
+            let email = u
+                .get("emailAddress")
+                .and_then(|v| v.as_str())
+                .unwrap_or("")
+                .to_string();
+            let active = if u.get("active").and_then(|v| v.as_bool()).unwrap_or(true) {
+                "yes".to_string()
+            } else {
+                "no".to_string()
+            };
+            vec![id, truncate(&name, 30), truncate(&email, 30), active]
+        })
+        .collect();
+
+    format::print_table(&headers, &rows);
+    Ok(())
+}
+
+async fn run_assignable(
+    project: &str,
+    query: &str,
+    site_opt: Option<&str>,
+    json: bool,
+) -> Result<(), String> {
+    let config = Config::load().map_err(|e| format!("Config error: {e}"))?;
+    let site = resolve_site(&config, site_opt)?;
+    let base_url = site.base_url.trim_end_matches('/').to_string();
+    let client = JiraClient::from_config(&config, false)
+        .await
+        .map_err(|e| format!("Auth error: {e}"))?;
+
+    let users = client
+        .search_assignable_users(&base_url, project, query)
+        .await?;
+
+    if json {
+        let serialized = serde_json::json!(users
+            .iter()
+            .map(|(id, name)| {
+                serde_json::json!({
+                    "accountId": id,
+                    "displayName": name
+                })
+            })
+            .collect::<Vec<_>>());
+        println!(
+            "{}",
+            serde_json::to_string_pretty(&serialized).unwrap_or_default()
+        );
+        return Ok(());
+    }
+
+    if users.is_empty() {
+        println!("{}", style::dim("No assignable users found."));
+        return Ok(());
+    }
+
+    let headers = ["ACCOUNT ID", "DISPLAY NAME"];
+    let rows: Vec<Vec<String>> = users.into_iter().map(|(id, name)| vec![id, name]).collect();
+
+    format::print_table(&headers, &rows);
+    Ok(())
+}
+
+fn resolve_site<'a>(
+    config: &'a Config,
+    site_opt: Option<&str>,
+) -> Result<&'a crate::config::Site, String> {
+    crate::cli::util::resolve_site_for_command(config, site_opt)
+}

+use serde::Serialize;

+#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize)]
+pub struct ActiveContextInfo {
+    pub name: String,
+    pub source: &'static str,
+    pub base_url: String,
+}
+
+pub fn current_context(config: &Config) -> Option<ActiveContextInfo> {
+    if let Ok(name) = std::env::var("TICK_SITE").or_else(|_| std::env::var("TICK_CONTEXT")) {
+        let name = name.trim();
+        if !name.is_empty() {
+            if let Some(site) = config.sites.iter().find(|s| s.name == name) {
+                return Some(ActiveContextInfo {
+                    name: site.name.clone(),
+                    source: "environment variable",
+                    base_url: site.base_url.clone(),
+                });
+            }
+        }
+    }
+    if let Some(name) = Config::read_active_context() {
+        let name = name.trim();
+        if !name.is_empty() {
+            if let Some(site) = config.sites.iter().find(|s| s.name == name) {
+                return Some(ActiveContextInfo {
+                    name: site.name.clone(),
+                    source: "context file (~/.config/tick/context)",
+                    base_url: site.base_url.clone(),
+                });
+            }
+        }
+    }
+    if let Some(ref name) = config.default_site {
+        let name = name.trim();
+        if !name.is_empty() {
+            if let Some(site) = config.sites.iter().find(|s| s.name == name) {
+                return Some(ActiveContextInfo {
+                    name: site.name.clone(),
+                    source: "config default_site",
+                    base_url: site.base_url.clone(),
+                });
+            }
+        }
+    }
+    if config.sites.len() == 1 {
+        return Some(ActiveContextInfo {
+            name: config.sites[0].name.clone(),
+            source: "default (single configured site)",
+            base_url: config.sites[0].base_url.clone(),
+        });
+    }
+    None
+}
+
+pub fn resolve_site_for_command<'a>(
+    config: &'a Config,
+    site_arg: Option<&str>,
+) -> Result<&'a Site, String> {
+    if let Some(name) = site_arg {
+        return config
+            .sites
+            .iter()
+            .find(|s| s.name == name)
+            .ok_or_else(|| format!("Unknown site '{name}'"));
+    }
+    if let Ok(name) = std::env::var("TICK_SITE").or_else(|_| std::env::var("TICK_CONTEXT")) {
+        let name = name.trim();
+        if !name.is_empty() {
+            return config
+                .sites
+                .iter()
+                .find(|s| s.name == name)
+                .ok_or_else(|| format!("Unknown site '{name}' from TICK_SITE/TICK_CONTEXT"));
+        }
+    }
+    if let Some(name) = Config::read_active_context() {
+        let name = name.trim();
+        if !name.is_empty() {
+            if let Some(site) = config.sites.iter().find(|s| s.name == name) {
+                return Ok(site);
+            }
+        }
+    }
+    if let Some(ref name) = config.default_site {
+        let name = name.trim();
+        if !name.is_empty() {
+            if let Some(site) = config.sites.iter().find(|s| s.name == name) {
+                return Ok(site);
+            }
+        }
+    }
+    if config.sites.len() == 1 {
+        return Ok(&config.sites[0]);
+    }
+    if config.sites.is_empty() {
+        return Err(
+            "No sites configured in config.toml. Run 'tick --init' to set up a site.".into(),
+        );
+    }
+    Err("Multiple sites configured. Set active server context with 'tick context use <site>' or pass --site <name>".into())
+}
+
+pub fn resolve_site<'a>(
+    config: &'a Config,
+    key: &str,
+    site_arg: Option<&str>,
+) -> Result<&'a Site, String> {
+    resolve_site_for_command(config, site_arg).map_err(|e| {
+        if e.starts_with("Multiple sites") {
+            format!("{e} for {key}")
+        } else {
+            e
+        }
+    })
+}
+
+pub fn require_site<'a>(config: &'a Config, name: &str) -> Result<&'a Site, String> {
+    config
+        .sites
+        .iter()
+        .find(|s| s.name == name)
+        .ok_or_else(|| format!("Unknown site '{name}'"))
+}
+
+/// `--body` argument or stdin when omitted (for piped comments).
+pub fn read_body_arg(body: Option<String>) -> Result<String, String> {
+    if let Some(b) = body {
+        if b.trim().is_empty() {
+            return Err("comment body must not be empty".into());
+        }
+        return Ok(b);
+    }
+    use std::io::Read;
+    let mut buf = String::new();
+    std::io::stdin()
+        .read_to_string(&mut buf)
+        .map_err(|e| format!("read stdin: {e}"))?;
+    if buf.trim().is_empty() {
+        return Err("comment body required: pass --body or pipe text on stdin".into());
+    }
+    Ok(buf)
+}
+
+pub fn parse_keys_list(keys: &[String]) -> Result<Vec<String>, String> {
+    let mut out = Vec::new();
+    for k in keys {
+        for part in k.split(',') {
+            let part = part.trim();
+            if part.is_empty() {
+                continue;
+            }
+            out.push(parse_issue_key_arg(part)?);
+        }
+    }
+    if out.is_empty() {
+        return Err("Provide at least one issue key (--keys)".into());
+    }
+    Ok(out)
+}
+
+pub fn parse_labels_input(raw: &str) -> Vec<String> {
+    raw.split(',')
+        .map(|s| s.trim().to_string())
+        .filter(|s| !s.is_empty())
+        .collect()
+}
